title: Ahsan Iqbal Visits Beijing for Pakistan's First Astronaut Departure
excerpt: Federal Minister Ahsan Iqbal travels to Beijing to attend the departure ceremony for Pakistan's first astronaut.
body_html:
Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Professor Ahsan Iqbal has traveled to Beijing, China.

The minister arrived in the capital city to attend the departure ceremony for Pakistan's first astronaut as they prepare to head into space.
